text:
Priya M: Heads up 1: EU pricing copy + calc localization sprint. Need final decisions so we can A/B the euro vs USD microcopy next week.
Jon (growth): Quick ask: test localized tier labels ("Developer","Team","Enterprise") vs value labels ("Pay-as-you-go","Committed","Dedicated"). Which resonates in DACH/FR markets?
Lina - PM: We're running a small panel with FR/DE reps on Wed. Carlos, can you pull two translated variants for the FAQ and calc helpers?
Carlos (intl): On it. Also propose adding VAT language: short line under prices: "+ VAT where applicable". Legal prefers concise.
Maya (design): UI change: when currency = EUR, switch calculator decimal separator to comma and show per-month examples. Small visual only.
Priya M: Good. For the calculator, can we add an optional toggle "Include tax" so users see gross estimate? Might improve intent signaling.
Jon (growth): Love toggle. Also plan to gate the benchmark webinar for leads with est_monthly_spend >= 500 (EUR). Lower threshold for EU.
Lina - PM: Routing rules we discussed should be extended: if calc.opt_in_tax == true -> send tax-aware estimate email. If est_monthly_spend >= 2000 -> route to EMEA.AE.
Nate (sales): Please also add tag: "demo_candidate" if company_size >= 50 and est_monthly_spend >= 1000. Sales will triage.
ops-bot: note: analytics.event("pricing_calc_used") will include fields: currency, est_monthly_spend, include_tax, toggle_optin.
Carlos (intl): Translations ready: FR + DE short FAQ draft here: https://drive.fake/intl-pricing-eu. I'll add translator notes.
Maya (design): Microcopy proposals for calc inputs: "tokens/request" -> "avg tokens / call", "calls/min" -> "requests / min", helper: "approx. monthly spend". For FR we might need longer helpers, keep them under 40 chars.
Priya M: FAQ tweak: replace long Q&A about SLA with "We meet industry SLOs; contact sales for strict SLAs." Keeps page scannable.
Jon (growth): Experiment matrix: (1) Tier-label variant A vs B, (2) Currency formatting (dot vs comma), (3) Webinar gating on est_spend threshold. We'll track CTR, sign quality, and demo requests.
Lina - PM: Timeline: translations by EOD Tue, design assets Wed AM, static push Thurs 08:30 CET to staging, QA Thurs afternoon, go/no-go Fri.
Carlos (intl): Also flag: some EU customers expect pricing examples with typical workloads. I'll draft two example stacks ("chatbot - 30k daily queries" and "search embeddings - 100k/month").
Nate (sales): Perfect 44C those examples will help qualify leads on first contact.
Maya (design): Note for eng: add CSS for currency-specific spacing and adjust calculator placeholder lengths for localized text.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: /pricing v1.14-eu at 2026-04-02 08:30 CET.
Priya M: Final approval: I'll review the staging snapshot Fri 10:00 CET. Please drop links to build and translation doc in this thread.
Jon (growth): I'll set up the A/B config in GrowthLab and share experiment IDs.
Lina - PM: Thanks all 4AA small, actionable items: Carlos -> translations, Maya -> microcopy + CSS notes, Ops -> event schema + routing hooks, Jon -> AB config, Nate -> demo tagging.
Carlos (intl): Translation doc link posted: https://drive.fake/intl-pricing-eu (comments enabled).
Priya M: Great work team 389 we'll include a short note in the benchmark launch about localized pricing examples.
